in_marathi.name: Ghasiram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who holds a bowl (Ghana + Siram)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ghasiram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ghasiram is derived from Sanskrit words 'Ghana' meaning 'to hold' and 'Siram' meaning 'bowl'. This name is given to a boy who is believed to hold the wisdom and knowledge of the universe in his hands, like a bowl. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted holding a bowl or a conch shell, symbolizing his nurturing and sustaining role in the universe.
